Thanks for the details, Martina — copying the most relevant steps below and a small CLI snippet you can hand to your cloud ops team.

1) SPN permissions: Contributor scoped to the publisher resource group is fine for the publisher activation flow. Avoid Owner or tenant-level roles. For the artifact publish step we only need rights to create the resource (storage/containers) used by the marketplace ingestion pipeline.

2) SKUs/manifests: You will upload one offer manifest that contains entries for both SKUs. Private SKUs require an associated private offer definition and entitlement mapping in the marketplace portal. I can provide the manifest template during the call.

3) Timeline & contacts: Marissa will be your commercial contact for MSA/pricing. I'll take point on the technical handoff and run the smoke test post-publish.

Azure CLI snippet (example — run as a tenant admin):

# create service principal and grant contributor to RG
az ad sp create-for-rbac --name "acme-publisher-spn" --role contributor --scopes /subscriptions/<SUB_ID>/resourceGroups/<PUBLISHER_RG> --sdk-auth > acme-spn.json

# validate the SPN has contributor on RG
az role assignment list --assignee <APP_ID> --scope /subscriptions/<SUB_ID>/resourceGroups/<PUBLISHER_RG>

I'll attach a short txt with the exact commands and common substitution notes.

[Attachment: azure-cli-spn-example.txt (text/plain)]
